cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(sakura_harnessbridge LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX "メモ: インクルード ファイル:  ")
set(CMAKE_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX "${CMAKE_CXX_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX}")

# Generated by tools/build/sakura_build.py. Do not edit.
get_filename_component(SAKURA_REPO_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../../../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../mingw-x64-debug.cmake")
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_OBJECT_PATH_MAX 220)

add_library(sakura_terminal_tmux_core STATIC
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxArgumentParser.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxCli.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxCommandDispatcher.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxFormatEvaluator.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxTargetResolver.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxArgumentParser.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxCli.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxCommandDispatcher.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxCommandTypes.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxFormatEvaluator.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/terminal/tmux/TmuxTargetResolver.h"
)
target_include_directories(sakura_terminal_tmux_core PUBLIC "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core")
target_compile_features(sakura_terminal_tmux_core PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(sakura_terminal_tmux_core PRIVATE -fpack-struct=8 -include "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/src/main/modules/generated/abi/mingw-x64-debug/sakura_terminal_tmux_core.h")
target_compile_definitions(sakura_terminal_tmux_core PRIVATE _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)

add_library(sakura_harnessbridge STATIC
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/harnessbridge/HarnessBridgeAuthenticatedSession.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/harnessbridge/HarnessBridgeBroker.cpp"

  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/platform/harnessbridge/HarnessBridgeServiceHost.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/harnessbridge/HarnessBridgeAuthenticatedSession.h"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/harnessbridge/HarnessBridgeBroker.h"

  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/harnessbridge/HarnessBridgeEndpoint.h"

  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/harnessbridge/HarnessBridgeTransport.h"
)
target_include_directories(sakura_harnessbridge PUBLIC "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include")

target_compile_features(sakura_harnessbridge PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(sakura_harnessbridge PRIVATE -fpack-struct=8 -include "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/src/main/modules/generated/abi/mingw-x64-debug/sakura_harnessbridge.h")

target_link_libraries(sakura_harnessbridge PRIVATE sakura_terminal_tmux_core)
target_link_libraries(sakura_harnessbridge PUBLIC advapi32 bcrypt)
